Home.metaTitle: Web, app and online store development

hero.eyebrow: Independent development · websites, stores, apps and plugins
hero.title: Watch how your next <accent>sale</accent> gets built.
hero.sub: I design and code custom websites, online stores and applications. What you see assembling here is the real order I work in: structure, content, commerce, forms and launch.
hero.xrayHint: Turn on X-ray at the top and see the skeleton of any page.

problems.title: Does any of these problems sound familiar?
problems.lead: Tell me where you are, pick a problem and see how I would approach it. I talk about possible results, not promised ones: they depend on each business and are measured from the start.
problems.statusDoneStarting: under way · how it would start
problems.statusDoneExisting: solved · how it would end up

pieces.title: Every piece is designed so someone buys, writes or comes back.
pieces.lead: These are not screenshots: you can use them. Add the chair to the cart, fill in the form, build an article. And if you want to see how they are made, ask each one for its skeleton.
